==Usage instructions==
The following is a list of the parameters used by this template.
#<code>image</code> &ndash; Takes a filename for use in the infobox.
#<code>name</code> &ndash; The name of the article's topic.
#<code>region</code> &ndash; The major galactic region (Outer Rim, Core Worlds, etc.) that the constellation falls in. 
#<code>sector</code> &ndash; The sector(s) that the constellation occurs in.
#<code>systems</code> &ndash; The star systems that the constellation spans.
#<code>coordinates</code> &ndash; The Atlas grid coordinates of the constellation.
#<code>xyz</code> -The XYZ galactic coordinates of the constellation.
#<code>suns</code> &ndash; Stars that make up the constellation.
#<code>orbits</code> &ndash; Planets that are included in the constellation.
#<code>stations</code> &ndash; Space stations included in the constellation.
#<code>asteroids</code> &ndash; Asteroids included in the constellation.
#<code>comets</code> &ndash; Comets included in the constellation.
#<code>nebulae</code> &ndash; Nebulae within or intersecting the constellation.
#<code>other</code> &ndash; Other celestial bodies in the constellation
#<code>routes</code> &ndash; Trade routes through the constellation.
#<code>quadrants</code> &ndash; Quadrants or other regions in the constellation.
#<code>species</code> &ndash; Species native to the constellation.
#<code>otherspecies</code> &ndash; Other species populous in the constellation.
#<code>language</code> &ndash; Primary language of the constellation.
#<code>population</code> &ndash; Population count of the constellation.
#<code>imports</code> &ndash; Major imports to the constellation.
#<code>exports</code> &ndash; Major exports from the constellation.
#<code>affiliation</code> &ndash; Any political or other affiliations


Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page, but should not be removed.
<pre><nowiki>{{Constellation
